name: Bruce Peninsula National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are welcome in the park, on a 3 m (9 ft) leash.
summary: Leashed pets are welcome in the park, on a 3 m (9 ft) leash.

excerpts.quote: Pets are welcome to visit the park.
Pets must be on a leash at all times – maximum length 3 m/9 ft.

dogRules.text: Leash no longer than 3 m (9 ft) at all times.
Never leave pets unattended at campsites or in vehicles; leaving a pet in a hot car is illegal.
Poison ivy is dense along trails; pets can carry its oil to people.
Store pet food and bowls in a hard-sided vehicle at Cyprus Lake campground.
